extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CORE FFO (CFFO) only; no AFFO, so affo fields are null/empty. CFFO does not subtract recurring capex; the quarterly recurring capex of $4.1 million (rounded, from the Investment Activity section) is recorded in recurring_capex_disclosed. The 'Prepayment (gains) losses on asset dispositions' line (-670) was categorized as debt_extinguishment since it relates to prepayment; it could alternatively be viewed as property-sale related. Diluted shares uses 'Weighted-average shares and units outstanding' (230,186,297), which reproduces $0.27 for both FFO and CFFO. Per-share checks: 62,263/230,186 = 0.27; 62,493/230,186 = 0.27. The reconciliation is also printed on seq 27 (printed 13) as the five-quarter table; values match.
